name: 19056 · Levittown, PA
findings: ZIP 19056 (Levittown) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19056 (Levittown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19056 (Levittown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
